shot_metadata.title: The Consumption - Visceral Feeding

prompt_variants.style: Close handheld shots of consumption, moving between faces and hands (that's where the camera is), visceral detail.
prompt_variants.subject:
Close view of hands reaching for food, tearing whale meat with fingers, purple juice running down chins, egg yolk dripping on clothes, everyone eating with desperate hunger despite the abundance, mouths stained all three colors.

Three long driftwood tables arranged in horseshoe shape in field, laden with whale meat, dried fish, berry juice in jugs, boiled eggs, bread, the tables bending slightly under weight, fifty people taking seats.
prompt_variants.action:
Hands everywhere reaching. No utensils. Fingers tear into whale blubber, white fat, red meat. Grease runs down wrists. Purple berry juice poured directly into mouths, overflowing, running down necks. Boiled eggs crushed in fists, yolk squirting between fingers. Everyone eating like starved despite full tables. Child gnaws whale bone. Woman drinks purple juice, eyes rolling back. Man stuffs mouth with fish and eggs simultaneously. The three stains now on everyone - blood on lips, berry juice on teeth, yolk on chins. Mixed together makes brown-black mark on faces. Same color as ground stain earlier. Magnús eats mechanically, jaw working steadily. Guðrún feeds Lilja, purple juice and whale fat. Sigrid only one not eating. Watches. Some people's chewing becomes rhythmic. Like cud chewing. Jaws moving wrong direction - sideways slightly. No one notices. Food disappearing impossibly fast but tables still full.

Tables covered with white cloth - where did cloth come from? Food arranged in patterns. Whale meat in center, still steaming. Dried fish in pyramids. Purple juice in clay jugs, liquid glowing slightly in evening light. Eggs boiled, shells removed, golden yolks visible. Fresh bread
prompt_variants.scene:
Feast tables, searchlight still on but flickering. Food being consumed desperately. Faces and hands stained.


Field near houses. Three tables in horseshoe. Evening light golden. Ocean visible in distance. Mountains surrounding.
